text:
Maria (Sales): Kicking off POC benchmark for Nimbus prospect. Needs: sustained mixed workload (embeds + chat gen) at ~500 qps, plus 99.9 tail latency targets for chat. Who can own the runbook and test harness? 

Jake (Solutions): I can draft the runbook. Proposal: two phases — 1) throughput soak (1h @ target qps), 2) tail-latency stress with synthetic spikes. Use k6 for control plane and our load-generator in repo. Key configs: model=redwood-1.3-large, seq=256 tokens gen, batch_sizes=[8,16,32], payload mix 70% chat-gen / 30% embed. 

Samir (Eng): I’ll run on a Dedicated pool we can reserve for 2h. Important ops notes: warm 5 minutes with persistent KV cache, enable continuous batching. Watch for cache-miss tail spikes. Suggest swarm config: workers=20, concurrency_per_worker=10, prewarm=3 replicas. 

Lydia (Security): Quick blocker: does sample data contain PII? If yes we need a sanitized dataset + config in customer zone. Also need to fill security questionnaire Q12 about E2E encryption and KMS usage before handing results to compliance. Please flag if any logs contain raw user text. 

Maria (Sales): Good call Lydia — we'll provide masked payloads. Alan (AE) pls confirm if customer can share a sanitized sample by EOD tomorrow. @Alan (AE) 

Alan (AE): I'll nudge them. They said yes to sanitized samples but asked for an estimate on cost impact if we keep Dedicated for 2 hrs vs reserved monthly. 

Jake (Solutions): Back-of-envelope pricing: 2h Dedicated run = ~0.12 * monthly reserved hourly rate? (ballpark) For sustained 500 qps on this model expect ~1.2 GPU-hours per minute => ~144 GPU-hours total for 2h at peak concurrency with warmups — rough calc. Add burst padding 30%. I'll write a clearer cost estimate in the runbook. 

Samir (Eng): Quick test summary after first soak (ran now on test cluster): sustained 520 qps for 60m ✅. Observed 99.9 latency ~4200ms on cache-miss windows (about 1.8% of requests) — appears correlated with KV refresh. Logs snippet: 
```
[2025-05-18T14:12:02Z] request_id=abc123 q=520 latency=92ms
[2025-05-18T14:52:08Z] request_id=def456 q=520 latency=4210ms cache_miss=true
```
I'll add histogram and heatmap to the writeup. 

Maria (Sales): Awesome — can you add a short "what we recommend" section (e.g., enable prefix caching + bump prewarm) and one-slide summary for the customer? I want to include cost impact and a remediation plan for the 99.9 spikes. 

Samir (Eng): Will do. Recommendation: increase KV prewarm TTL, enable request coalescing, and try batch_size=16 for gen-heavy traffic. Re-run tail stress after config change. 

Lydia (Security): Once you have the sanitized logs and the writeup, send them to me for the questionnaire. Mark any samples that include synthetic user identifiers. 

deploy-bot: deploy:redwood-test-bench -> success at 2025-05-18T14:00:00Z :rocket: 

Maria (Sales): Plan: run second pass after config tweak tomorrow 09:00 PT, compile customer-facing PDF and cost estimate by EOD. Alan, I'll loop you once writeup ready.

Jake (Solutions): Runbook draft link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/nimbus-poc-bench (will update)
